**Jung-Jun Hwang** is a Korean-American Hot Wheels designer who has been working with Mattel since 2019. He currently works as a lead designer for Hot Wheels Track and Playsets; prior to his role at Mattel, he worked for Skyrocket Toys and competing brand Jakks Pacific and was an intern at [Philips](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philips) and Columbia Sportswear.
